description: Traffic viewer now hides Pi/router/switch infrastructure traffic. Adds optional env overrides for infrastructure IP detection.

add.description: Last-octet count used to derive switch management IPs from SWITCH_HOSTS. Leave at default unless switches use unusual addressing.
Management VLAN gateway IP to exclude from the traffic viewer (optional; auto-derived from DB when blank).
UDM router IP to exclude from the traffic viewer (optional; falls back to ISP router table).
Teltonika/OpenWRT router IP to exclude from the traffic viewer (optional; falls back to ISP router table).

notes: All values are optional — infrastructure IPs are auto-derived from the DB (ISP routers, VLAN SVIs) when unset. Restart the web container after the update.
